scope: Twenty-four domain families but only four shared logical patterns. This tests lexical/domain transfer, not unseen logical form. Labels are constructed, not human gold.
selection_reason: Baseline controls; two adaptive reviewers with zero TP harm and 11/12 FP recovery in dev; native control with no incremental dev gain; formal+graph negative control with no incremental dev gain. Expensive always-review variants omitted after identical dev labels. No trained aggregator: eight families insufficient to fit and certify one.
b: ministral-14b-latest from server env, unchanged from dev
phi: same prompt/schema/signed-Horn solver and env model as corrected dev; first materialize all 160 translations gold-blind then freeze under separate sealed config
gpu: one resident Granite BYOC native worker, model revision ab01ccca5dcfb80246369a086a4a87a29198f5af; warm/cold in traces
runs: Five service arms and Phi frontend can run concurrently in separate pinned checkouts. M11 follows completed Phi freeze. No sealed scorer/gold inspection until BOTH service runs complete.
future_default_rule: Prefer an adaptive reviewer only if it improves paired FP without new FN on sealed; remove helpers with no incremental improvement. Treat constructed transfer separately from competition claims.
